newsitem.title: INDIA: India Hindalco sees bright future ahead.
newsitem.headline: India Hindalco sees bright future ahead.

text.p: India's largest private aluminium maker, Hindalco Industries Ltd, said on Wednesday it saw a bright future ahead.

"With our well-defined business strategy, the completion of the ongoing capital expenditure programme and the utilisation of enhanced capacities and facilities, the outlook for the future is exceedingly bright," Chairman Kumar Mangalam Birla said in a statement distributed at the company's annual general meeting.

"Higher volumes, and a large share of value-added products improved cost efficiency, strengthening international prices and increased aluminium potential will fuel Hindalco's growth to new heights," Birla added.

Earlier, Hindalco had announced that its sales in the first four months of financial year 97/98 (April- March) had risen 26 percent. Over the same four-month period, its primary metal output had climbed 21 percent.
No further details were immediately available.
